scan_matrix_2026-09-10.derivation_note: Cycle scan_2026-09-10 was MEASURED and deliberately never reported: its judgements were refused by its own gate and the judgement of record is the re-judgement scan_2026-09-10_rj2. This matrix is the side effect of reporting it, so the repository does not hold it and tests/test_scan_figures.py skips the figure suite on exactly that absence (cc_tasks/2026-09-10_harness_v5_blind.md decision 6). The four Results COMPUTED_FROM it are counts of the COLLECTION, which the payload named in derivable_from holds in full; running the derivation command with the generator output root pointed at a temporary tree reproduces them without producing the side effect. Decision of record: cc_tasks/2026-09-13_ephemeral_provenance.md decision 1.
scan_matrix_2026-09-10.description: The Tier A matrix of cycle scan_2026-09-10, whose JUDGEMENTS the cycle's gate refused to register and whose COLLECTION is what this registers. Task cc_tasks/2026-09-11_l0_report_cycle4_revision.md.

scan_matrix_2026-09-10_rj1.description: The scan_2026-09-10_rj1 matrix: the scan_2026-09-10 cycle's stored Observations re-judged under harness-v5. Re-judged under harness-v5 (DD-064): a URL inside the product that robots.txt forbids is BLIND, not scope, so no verdict rests on a page the collector was never allowed to read. Same Observations, same evidence, a judgement layer that knows what it did not see. Written by scripts/scan_report.py. (cc_tasks/2026-09-10_rejudge_2_3_4.md)
scan_matrix_2026-09-10_rj1.name: scan_matrix_2026-09-10_rj1

scan_matrix_2026-09-10_rj2.description: The scan_2026-09-10_rj2 matrix: scan_2026-09-10's stored Observations re-judged under generation 9. Re-judged under generation 9 (`RULE-A3-v6`, `RULE-B3-v3`): an ABSENCE claim reached over a candidate set with a BLIND member is a scope limitation and owes `error`, not `fail` (ISA 705; DD-052 §6). Same Observations, nothing re-fetched, no Observation created — the evidence is the measured cycle's and the judgement is generation 9's. Written by scripts/scan_report.py. (cc_tasks/2026-09-11_rejudge_1_2_3_4_gen9.md)
